title: Laamu ngu ronkaama
intro: E nder leyɗeele ɓooyɗe, laamu doole meeɗiino jogaade doole, ina yamira jawdi keewndi e nguurndam yimɓe ɓe limotaako. Hay so tawii maale laaɓtuɗe e jeertinaali ina ngoodi, oo laamɗo suɓii ko laawol ƴaañorgal, addani ɗum jokkere enɗam luggiɗnde, nde ƴoogata e nder sahaa.
clues: Miɗo ɗaɓɓa doole e laamu timmuɗo e dow domen mawɗo.
Mi luulndiima nulaaɗo lesɗikiniiɗo mo Joomiraawo laamuuji kala neldi.
Leñol am ina anndiranoo jogaade njuɓɓudi mawndi e maayo jogorngo jogaade siwil men.
Miɗo seedtoo maandeeji kaawis keewɗi, ina heen sawru waylitoondu mboddi e junngo jalboongo.
Mi saliima yo fedde maccuɓe yaltu leydi am, hay so tawii ko yamiroore Alla.
Rewde am e yimɓe yahooɓe ɓee, addani mi e konu am e nder ɓernde maayo fecciingo.
arabic: فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ فَأَغْرَقْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَكَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا غَـٰفِلِينَ
verse: So We took retribution from them, and We drowned them in the sea because they denied Our signs and were heedless of them. (7:136)
